**Recommendation:** Apply now, lead with your latency and settlement results, and build a small Go payments project to close the language gap.

coverLetter:
Priya Raman
Toronto, Canada
priya.raman@example.com
+1 555 0176

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Coinbase

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your north star is payment success rate, and that depends on a payment platform that stays fast and correct under heavy load. At Lumen Payments I designed and ran the settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot, processing about 40 million events a day on Kafka, and I cut the p99 latency of the payment status API from 480 ms to 120 ms by moving hot reads from PostgreSQL to Redis.

That is the work your Payments team describes: scalable, low-latency APIs and high-volume transactional systems where precision matters. I have 11 years of experience building payment and event-processing services, and I led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month migration from a monolith to 6 services. I was also on call for the payments platform and wrote the post-incident reviews for 14 incidents, so owning features from design through production support is how I already work. My production languages are Kotlin, Java and Python rather than Go, but the service design, event-driven architecture and API design carry over directly. I took a planned career break to care for a family member, and I kept current with AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification (2024) and by contributing bug fixes to an open-source Kotlin library.

Turning Coinbase's payments stack into a self-serve, API-driven platform is the kind of problem I want to work on next. I'm available to start a conversation at your convenience and can walk you through the settlement service design in detail.

Best regards,
Priya Raman

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Senior Backend Engineer, Priya Raman
applicationEmail.body:
Hello Coinbase Payments team,

I designed and ran a settlement service in Kotlin and Spring Boot at Lumen Payments that processed about 40 million events a day on Kafka, and I'd like to bring that payments experience to your Payments Platform team. Over 11 years I've built payment and event-processing services, led a team of 4 engineers through a 9 month monolith-to-services migration, and stayed on call for the platform I built. My CV and cover letter are attached, with the details of that work. I'm available for a call any weekday this week and can start a conversation whenever suits you.

Best regards,
Priya Raman
